question: Shanta and VP Dhananjaya were awarded the Rashtriya Kalidas Samman for 2020-21 for significant contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam **is a major form of **Indian classical dance **that originated **in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The **Natya Shastra **by **Bharata Muni **and **Abhinaya Darpana **by **Nandikeshvara **are considered to be the **original sources **of **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• The dance form is also briefly mentioned in the **Kannada text Manasollasa **written by **Someshwara III**.
 
• **Lord Shiva **is considered the **god of this dance form**. 
 
• The **Kalidas Samman **is a **prestigious arts award **presented **annually **by the **government of Madhya Pradesh **in **India.**
 
• The award is **named **after **Kālidāsa**, a renowned **Classical Sanskrit writer **of **ancient India**. The **Kalidas Samman **was **first awarded **in **1980.**
 
• **Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan** and **Shanta Dhananjayan**, also known as the **Dhananjayans**, they are the **dancing couple of India **and **were awarded Padma Bhushan in 2009**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odissi__ **also referred to as **Orissa **in **old literature**, is a major ancient **Indian classical dance **that originated in the **Hindu temples of Odisha**
 
• **__Kathakali__ **is a **major form of classical Indian dance**.
 
• It is a **"story play" **genre of art, but one distinguished by the elaborately **colorful make-up**, **costumes**, and **face masks **that the traditionally **male actor-dancers wear**.
 
• **__Kuchipudi__ **is one of the **eight major Indian classical dances**.
 
• It **originates **from a **village named Kuchipudi **in the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
